policy.comment: Navigation and ordinary interaction are allowed everywhere. Only the action classes below escalate, and only off the trusted list. Add domains you want fully autonomous to trustedDomains.

eval.comment: browser_eval runs on any page except these domains (and their subdomains). Identity, payment and banking hosts by default; edit to suit.

diagnostics.comment: Console and page-error capture runs only on development hosts: localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, *.localhost, *.local, *.test, private IPs, and the hosts listed here. Failed network requests are recorded on every host (invisible to the page).

evidence.comment: Each visit and screenshot is recorded under <stateDir>/sessions/<session>/ with a viewport image; directories older than retainDays are removed at startup.
